runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
OM B M-25-21 does not set a fine for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline. The passages I found contain no monetary penalty or fine for that situation.

The deadline itself is in the memo. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications. The memo also says agencies must make their AI Strategies publicly available, but I found no consequence attached to missing the deadline.

The only enforcement-type consequence I found concerns high-impact AI that is not performing properly, and it is not a fine. When the high-impact AI is not performing at an appropriate level, agencies must have a plan to discontinue its use until actions are taken to achieve compliance with this memorandum. If proper risk mitigation is not possible, agencies must cease the use of the AI.

I searched only this memo, so I can't rule out penalties in other OMB documents or statutes it references.

The passage states the plan to discontinue non-performing high-impact AI and the requirement to cease use if risk mitigation is not possible.
